purpose: Generate final normal-job combat data for all canonical Heroes from UnityDataTool direct JSON, including display job stats, Hero-owned soldier modifiers, talent star progression, awakening and canonical equipable skill cost, while preserving the A-1/A-9 identity and relation ownership boundaries.

sharedRelationBoundary.soldierModifiersMeaning: Hero-owned troop HP/ATK/DEF/MDEF modifier percentages only; this component is not Hero-Soldier membership.
sharedRelationBoundary.futureConsumer: Hero 5-3 consumes the validated data/generated/hero-soldier-by-hero.v1.json index only after the shared Relation Layer is accepted.

semanticGates.rule: At Hero Lv70 / 6-star, for each normal JobConnection final JobLevel: round((INI + UP * (70 - 1) / 10) * (1 + HeroInfo.StatStar[5] / 10000)) + global JobInfo mastery flat.
semanticGates.scope: Bond percentage/flat effects are intentionally excluded and remain Hero Stage 5 data.
Hero-owned troop stat metadata only; never usable-Soldier membership.

semanticGates.rule: JobConnectionInfo.TalentSkill_IDs is the verified talent reference set.
TalentSkill_IDs[star - 1] selects the displayed talent for star 1..6; all normal JobConnections for one Hero must carry the same six-slot array.

For Stage 4-4 jobLevelAcquisitions only, resolve ConfigDataSkillInfo.SkillCost by exact skillId and project it as skill.cost. Missing, non-integer or values outside the frozen equipable domain {1,2} are hard errors.
semanticGates.scope: Do not project SkillCost onto heroDirectSkills, hiddenSkills, talent, awakening, SP rewards or other unproven skill paths.

normalizationRules: Consume Stage 4-3 and Stage 4-4 only when their status is PASS or REVIEW.
Use heroId as the only canonical Hero JOIN key and require exact parity with the frozen 267-record Hero Master.
Select playable HeroInfo records by the presence of the playable-Hero Useable schema; do not take the first duplicate raw ID from the 28k-row mixed table.
Use UnityDataTool direct JSON arrays; legacy TextAsset m_bytes parsing is forbidden in Stage 4-5.
Use JobInfo Property1-3 rewards only when PropertyModify IDs map to HP=87, AT=88, DF=89, Magic=90, MagicDF=91, DEX=92; unknown nonzero mastery IDs are hard errors.
Compute display stats for each normal JobConnection using its final JobLevel and add global mastered-job flat rewards after star-adjusted rounding.
Keep bond effects outside Stage 4 so Stage 5 can own bond semantics without double counting.
Require six star-correction values for every stat and six TalentSkill_IDs for every Hero talent set.
Keep soldierModifiers limited to Hero-owned troop stat percentages and never embed soldierId arrays or Hero-Soldier membership.
Preserve Stage 4-3 topology and Stage 4-4 skill acquisition payloads without changing their semantic ownership.
For Stage 4-4 jobLevelAcquisitions only, resolve ConfigDataSkillInfo.SkillCost by exact skillId and add it to the existing resolved skill payload as cost.
Fail closed when an equipable job-level skill has missing, non-integer, zero, 3, 4, 5 or any other SkillCost outside the frozen observed domain {1,2}; do not coerce, infer or fall back.
Do not add SkillCost to heroDirectSkills, hiddenSkills, talent, awakening, SP rewards or other paths whose equipable-cost semantics were not proven.

FAIL: Canonical Hero, Stage 4-3, Stage 4-4 or playable HeroInfo sets disagree.
A required Job, JobConnection, JobLevel, Skill or Awaken reference is missing or ambiguous.
A stat star-correction array or TalentSkill_IDs array is not six slots.
TalentSkill_IDs differ between normal JobConnections of the same Hero.
A nonzero JobInfo mastery PropertyModify ID is outside the verified 87-92 mapping.
A Cmd modifier is negative, non-integer or not divisible by 100.
A Stage 4-4 jobLevelAcquisition skill has no exact SkillInfo row, missing/non-integer SkillCost, SkillCost outside {1,2}, or a mismatched resolved skillId.
Stage 4-5 embeds or independently computes usable-Soldier membership.
PASS: 267 records are generated with all semantic gates verified, zero hard errors, A-1 identity parity and A-9 ownership preserved, and every equipable job-level skill carries exact SkillInfo SkillCost.

stage4CompletionRule: Stage 4 is COMPLETE only when the generated summary status is PASS with generatedHeroCount=267 and unresolvedComponents empty.
nextStage: Proceed to Hero Stage 5. Hero 5-3 usable Soldiers must consume the validated A-7 byHeroId index rather than recomputing membership.
